# Step - r_trim

`r_trim` · `rTrim` · category: [Strings and type conversion](../../traversal/step_reference.md#strings-and-type-conversion)

Removes trailing whitespace (Unicode White_Space) from each string.

## Forms

```text
r_trim()
r_trim(arg1: Scope)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.inject(" a  ").r_trim().next()   // a
```
